description: pkix-lint/src/lib.rs:664-671 — LintProfile has lint_runner() as a required method with no default, yet the doc comment says 'this clones the lint IDs by rebuilding from a new Vec'. If the intent is that all LintProfile impls should have the same default implementation (build a LintRunner from all_lints()), provide a default: fn lint_runner(&self) -> LintRunner { LintRunner::new(self.lints().iter().map(|_| todo!()).collect()) }. More precisely, Lint objects cannot be cheaply cloned (no Clone bound), so the comment 'clones the lint IDs' is misleading — lint_runner actually calls all_lints() afresh (CabfTlsBrProfile) rather than using self.lints(). The trait should document this correctly or provide a default that uses the lints() return value.
title: LintProfile::lint_runner default impl is missing; doc says allocation but trait has no default
